purpose: Public advisory opt-in engineering profiles; product repositories own executable commands and acceptance.

interpretation.core: Planning priority for an existing justified product need; not a mandate to add every language.
interpretation.selective: Use only for a concrete product or operational need.
interpretation.conditional: Require an established interoperability/framework need and an owned toolchain.
interpretation.specialized: Require a systems/native or measured requirement and target-specific qualification.
interpretation.command_examples: Templates with prerequisites; callers bind actual existing commands. This catalog does not claim the named example script exists in a receiving product.

workflow.working_directory: existing relative directory inside caller checkout
workflow.verify_command: required reviewed product command producing receipts
tool_setup_limits: pnpm, uv, JDK/Gradle, CMake, databases, browsers and container runtimes remain product-provisioned or verified.
Rust setup requires existing rustup and an exact stable toolchain; optional RustSec is product-owned.
Executable test commands remain executable code; read-only token scope is not a sandbox.

version_policy.support_verification: Verify upstream support, maintenance, advisories and end-of-support before adopting/updating a pin; record date and primary source.
version_policy.pins: Use exact stable supported versions compatible with the existing product; no silent latest/wildcard/prerelease selection.
version_policy.locks: Preserve the actual dependency owner and committed graph. Missing/inconsistent required locks fail; verification does not repair them.
version_policy.source_integrity: Compare relevant manifest/lock digests before and after verification.

profiles.dependency_owner: Existing migration ledger and database service owner

synthetic schema/role fixtures and executable SQL assertions
required_lock_alternatives: pinned test database image digest and migration-tool dependency lock or verified tool artifact
prerequisites: The opted-in job creates a disposable isolated test database; no production URL or credentials are used.
Preflight verifies the test endpoint, instance and role before SQL execution.
The actual migration directory and historical replay portability are established before applying candidate SQL.
tests/ci.sql below is an example binding; it must be a real owner-reviewed assertion file.

command_examples.requires: CI_TEST_DATABASE_URL is generated for the verified disposable job-local test service, not passed from production secrets.

acceptance: Record the real PostgreSQL version/extensions, migration versions and exact source.
Prove authorized save, read on a fresh independent connection, another client's read/write denial and stale-write rejection without an extra record.
Check native-session and grant revocation, least-privileged roles, rollback behavior and concurrent requests where claimed.
A shared-connection emulator is labeled separately and does not qualify PostgreSQL concurrency or network/TLS behavior.
No production ledger repair or migration is performed by this profile.
